camera.description: 雨夜旧宅门厅，小满推门而入，背后雨幕逆光勾出剪影，低机位仰拍小满面部大特写，水珠沿发梢滴落

audio.speech: 林伯，好兴致啊。雨这么大，晚宴还照开——就不怕故人上门？

prompt: Extreme close-up at a low angle: a young woman pushes open a heavy carved wooden door of an old mansion on a rainy night and steps into the foyer, her face filling the frame, backlit by the glowing rain curtain behind her, water droplets dripping from her hair. She is Xiaoman, a Chinese woman in her early twenties, pale rain-damp skin, sleek black shoulder-length hair with fine water droplets at the tips, calm defiant dark eyes, wearing a tailored charcoal-black wool blazer over a white shirt. Cool steel-blue moonlight from the storm outside rims her silhouette and the thousands of backlit rain streaks; a warm dim amber foyer lamp wraps one side of her cheek; the old door's wet walnut wood grain glistens; thin mist drifts through the backlight beam. Cinematic photorealistic live-action Chinese short-drama look, natural detailed skin texture, filmic color grade of warm amber banquet glow against cool rain-blue night tones, soft volumetric practical lighting, 35mm anamorphic lens look, shallow depth of field, rich micro-contrast, graceful natural motion, vertical 9:16 portrait framing, no on-screen text, no watermark, no subtitles.
